states.content: Asha Patel is at the clinic for an urgent neurology follow-up after an emergency-department visit; she had a first seizure-like spell two nights ago, and the ED asked her to see neurology this week. The ED note describes her presentation as a probable first unprovoked seizure. Asha is the patient with the seizure workup. Nurse Lucy is bringing her back for vitals and the neurology intake questions.
states.subject: patient_asha_patel

states.content: Post-MRI plan for Asha Patel has three current items: continue levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily, keep no driving for 6 months from March 12, and follow up in 6 weeks after Friday's visit. Asha asked for a summary of these three items. Earlier plan items (brain MRI with and without contrast, routine EEG) have been completed; levetiracetam has been started.
states.subject: patient_asha_patel

states.content: Asha Patel's updated calendar has three visits: EEG on Friday April 4 at 2:00 PM, MRI on Tuesday April 8 at 7:15 PM, and neurology follow-up on Friday April 11 at 11:30 AM. These replace the first-booked times of Thursday April 3 at 8:00 AM EEG, Monday April 7 at 6:30 PM MRI, and Thursday April 10 at 10:00 AM neurology follow-up. Asha states she needs later appointments and that morning testing will not work this week. The routine EEG has now been completed without complications, and preliminary neurology review found the routine EEG is normal; nurse Omar reports the routine EEG is normal. Asha Patel reports no change yet in her status after the EEG. The brain MRI has now been completed, per lab tech Erin. A reminder was sent for the MRI on Tuesday April 8 at 7:15 PM, and Asha confirms she saw it; lab tech Erin reports Asha's MRI check-in is complete. Clinician Dr. Mehta reports the MRI result showed no acute lesion and no clear structural trigger seen; Asha Patel expressed relief at this result. Clinician Dr. Kim states that a normal routine EEG does not change the current plan today for Asha Patel. For the EEG, the EEG department asks patients to arrive 20 minutes early with clean, dry hair and no gel or styling products. Scheduler Noah confirms the neurology follow-up on Friday April 11 at 11:30 AM remains booked and is the remaining scheduled item before closure of Asha Patel's workup.
